title: Solar Closeout Exceptions: Missing Serial Numbers, Changed Equipment, and Incomplete Handover Evidence
summary: Resolve solar closeout evidence conflicts before marking a customer handover packet complete.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Solar closeout exceptions should separate missing equipment identity, inconsistent scope revisions, absent technical records and incomplete customer handover. A Genie can identify the gap and assemble the evidence needed to resolve it. The exception should name the affected device or document, its source, the responsible owner and the blocked action. The agent must not fill missing serials, reuse another project's evidence or treat a delivered file as customer acceptance.


Explore the complete[solar installation and o&m services integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/construction/solar-installation-service) for the systems and processes around this guide.
